a421v-kv31-membrane-trafficking-impaired: In juvenile Kcnc1-A421V mice, less Kv3.1 reaches the surface of parvalbumin interneurons and more of it stays inside the cell.
a421v-mice-die-before-122d: Every Kcnc1-A421V mouse dies before 122 days of age, while wild-type littermates live on.
a421v-spatial-learning-working-memory-im: Young adult Kcnc1-A421V mice are slower to learn the Barnes maze and alternate less in the Y-maze, but retain what they learned.
a421v-weight-reduced-milestones-normal: Kcnc1-A421V mice weigh less and have smaller brains than littermates, yet reach the usual early developmental milestones on time.
alt-inhibitory-dysfunction-present-juven: Inhibition in Kcnc1-A421V mice is already impaired in juveniles, so the deficit is fixed from the start rather than worsening with age.
excitatory-neurons-unaffected-adult: Excitatory neurons in adult Kcnc1-A421V mice fire like wild-type ones, apart from needing slightly less current to start firing.
excitatory-neurons-unaffected-juvenile: Excitatory neurons in juvenile Kcnc1-A421V mice show normal synaptic transmission and normal excitability.
hypothesis-a421v-causes-kv31-lof: The A421V variant weakens Kv3.1 by keeping the channel from reaching the cell surface, not by changing how the channels that arrive work.
hypothesis-pv-dysfunction-drives-encepha: Losing Kv3.1 in parvalbumin interneurons is by itself enough to produce the seizures, sudden death and cognitive deficits of KCNC1 disease.
hypothesis-pv-in-selective-vulnerability: Kv3.1 loss impairs fast-spiking parvalbumin interneurons and spares excitatory neurons, hitting hardest where Kv3.2 cannot compensate.
in-vivo-hypersynchronous-discharges-muta: Awake Kcnc1-A421V mice show bursts of synchronised cortical activity accompanied by brief twitches, and wild-type mice never do.
in-vivo-pv-minus-transient-frequency-inc: During quiet rest, excitatory cells in Kcnc1-A421V mice are active more often while parvalbumin cells respond more weakly.
inhibitory-dysfunction-progresses-to-adu: Inhibitory transmission is normal in juvenile Kcnc1-A421V mice and impaired by young adulthood, so the deficit emerges with age.
kcnc1-wet-lab-primary-claims: The paper's main phenotype claims rest on the knock-in mouse colony and bench recordings, and cannot be checked from deposited data alone.
layer-v-pv-ins-subtle-impairment: Layer V parvalbumin interneurons in juvenile mutants are only mildly impaired, firing less at the strongest current injections.
prediction-cognitive-deficits: Kcnc1-A421V mice should be slower to learn the Barnes maze and show weaker Y-maze working memory, with no locomotor explanation.
prediction-excitatory-neurons-spared: Excitatory neurons should be unaffected in Kcnc1-A421V mice at both juvenile and adult ages, since they barely rely on Kv3.1.
prediction-impairment-grades-with-kv31-d: Deficits should be largest in parvalbumin cells that depend most on Kv3.1 and milder where Kv3.2 can take over.
prediction-kv31-surface-expression-reduc: Mutant parvalbumin interneurons should hold less Kv3.1 at the membrane and more inside the cell, while the remaining channels open normally.
prediction-network-hyperexcitability-in-: Awake Kcnc1-A421V mice should show synchronised cortical discharges and more active excitatory cells during quiet rest.
prediction-progressive-synaptic-failure: Inhibitory synapses made by parvalbumin interneurons should work normally in juveniles and release transmitter differently in young adults.
prediction-pv-in-firing-impaired: Parvalbumin interneurons in mutants should fire more slowly with broader, less sharply repolarising spikes, already in juveniles.
prediction-pv-in-k-current-reduced: Parvalbumin interneurons carrying one copy of the variant should lose voltage-gated potassium current, and lose more than half of it.
prediction-seizures-and-sudep: Kcnc1-A421V mice should have spontaneous convulsive seizures on video-EEG and die suddenly after tonic-clonic seizures.
pv-in-ap-waveform-altered-downstroke-apd: Spikes in mutant parvalbumin interneurons repolarise more slowly and last longer, at both juvenile and adult ages.
pv-in-inhibitory-synapse-altered-adult: In adult mutants, inhibitory signals from parvalbumin interneurons onto excitatory cells are larger but weaken faster during repeated firing.
pv-in-inhibitory-synapse-intact-juvenile: In juvenile mutants, inhibitory transmission from parvalbumin interneurons onto excitatory cells is no different from wild-type.
pv-ins-impaired-maximal-firing: Parvalbumin interneurons from Kcnc1-A421V mice cannot sustain the high firing rates that wild-type cells reach.
pv-ins-reduced-k-current-density: Parvalbumin interneurons in Kcnc1-A421V mice carry less voltage-gated potassium current than wild-type cells.
rtn-neurons-impaired-excitability: Parvalbumin neurons of the reticular thalamic nucleus in juvenile mutants fire fewer rebound spikes and repolarise more slowly.
scope-a421v-knockin-mouse: All claims come from one heterozygous Kcnc1-A421V knock-in mouse line, studied in somatosensory cortex and thalamus at set ages.
spontaneous-seizures-and-sudep-kcnc1: Most Kcnc1-A421V mice have spontaneous convulsive seizures on video-EEG and some die suddenly after one, while wild-types have none.
